title: SourcingPackManifest
description: Manifest for a Sourcing Pack. Declares: the source-side panels the Pack contributes (with their closed slot sets), optional additive slots the Pack adds onto engine-owned target panels, KS list, optional Instructions Provider, requested external tools (upper bound). Engine validates the panel DAG (engine-owned target panels + Pack-owned source panels + Pack extension slots) at registration; cycles are rejected. Pack-owned source-panel names SHOULD be Pack-namespaced (e.g. `itip:SourceUnit`); when two Packs in the same Run declare the same panel name with non-identical valueSchemaRef OR non-identical slots, the engine rejects registration (collision). Identical panel declarations across Packs are merged silently (same name + same valueSchemaRef + same slots).

id.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the Pack.

instructionsProvider.description: URI of the Pack's Instructions Provider descriptor.

panels.description: Pack-owned source-side panel declarations. Engine-owned target-spine panels (Definition/Archetype/Statement/Granularity/Evidence/Confidence) MUST NOT appear here; use `extendsPanels` to add additive slots onto them.

name.description: Pack-namespaced panel name. SHOULD match `<packPrefix>:<PanelName>` (e.g. `itip:SourceUnit`); engine collision-rejects identical names with non-identical schema/slots across Packs.

valueSchemaRef.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the panel value JSON Schema. Resolution rule: engine looks up the schema first as a resource bundled in the Pack JAR at `/META-INF/gsmarc/<URI-path-tail>`; falls back to the configured Schema Registry if any. The URI is informational + cache key; no network fetch is implied.

slots.description: Closed contribution-type set (one slot = one panel property).

dependsOnPanels.description: DAG edges. Engine-owned panel names allowed for upward bridges.

extendsPanels.description: Optional additive slots the Pack registers onto engine-owned panels (Definition/Archetype/Statement/Granularity/Evidence/Confidence). Slot names MUST be Pack-namespaced (e.g. `itip:Refined`); engine-defined slots remain closed and cannot be redefined. Use case: a domain Pack augments Statement with a refinement slot that downstream domain KSs read alongside the engine-defined Draft slot.

knowledgeSources.description: URIs of KS descriptors shipped by the Pack.

requestedExternalTools.description: Upper-bound list of external tools any KS in this Pack may declare in its descriptor's externalTools[]. Operator's RunConfig narrows further by binding names to host paths.
